subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which ignored human-readable group-entry metadata key should OpenClaw standardize on, and should it apply across every channel group/channel entry in the public config contract?
rationale: This is a public config-surface addition, and the repository policy requires maintainer intent before adding new config/default surface or allowing parallel field names.

options.title: Standardize on `name`
options.body: Add optional `name` as the cross-channel group-entry display metadata field, aligned with existing account/display naming patterns, and document that it is ignored for routing/security.

options.title: Use `label` for metadata
options.body: Add optional `label` instead if maintainers want to avoid confusing user-authored metadata with upstream channel names or runtime display names.

options.title: Defer cross-channel metadata
options.body: Keep this issue open but only land narrower channel-specific work such as WhatsApp runtime name matching until a broader config contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Standardize on `name`
recommendation.body: Add optional `name` as the cross-channel group-entry display metadata field, aligned with existing account/display naming patterns, and document that it is ignored for routing/security.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest current schema-history and prior-review connection to this config contract decision.
